periods.time: Second morning of the US Pacific Fleet attack on Tokyo
periods.location: Tokyo Bay defensive line and Tokyo underground city
periods.summary: The second US wave reveals PSYON's true nature on Japanese soil: hundreds of Abraham Carter clones teleport behind the self-defense lines, use pyrokinesis, electrokinesis and psychokinesis to shatter the front, and allow EDY units to penetrate Tokyo's underground city. Renren, Ikazuchi, Oreki and Kaieda are overwhelmed, while Itsuki orders even low-rank student knights into the underground defense layer. Upton uses the chaos to prepare Enterprise's hadron cannon against the civilian shelter.
periods.cause: The US combines the Pacific Fleet, EDY, Enterprise and PSYON clone forces after the first day's assault fails to decide the battle.
periods.process: Japanese troops expect a fight similar to the previous day, but identical Abraham clones teleport past artillery and fire lines. They cripple students and knights; Kaieda can kill some but is eventually pinned. EDY swarm the city center and breach the underground layers. Itsuki, commanding from the operations center, deploys every available defender, including D- and E-rank students like Ayase. In the air, Upton reveals PSYON to Kurono and exploits her distraction to bind her and aim at Tokyo.
periods.outcome: Tokyo's defense nearly collapses, forcing Kurono into her awakening and bringing the underground defense to its final line.
periods.significance: Shows the strategic horror of mass-produced Desperado-class clones and creates the crisis that unlocks Kurono's Three Thousand Worlds.
